h1: Media Walls in Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds & Cambridge

intro.html: A media wall is more than just a home for your television: it’s a way to bring style, order and functionality into your living room. At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we specialise in designing and building bespoke media walls that transform homes across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and surrounding areas.

With over 40 years of combined carpentry experience, we know how to balance practicality with design. Every media wall is custom-built, taking into account your space, your lifestyle, and your equipment. The result is a sleek, clutter-free feature that makes a real impact.

chapters.heading: Transform Your Living Space with a Bespoke Media Wall

blocks.html: Modern homes often revolve around technology (TVs, soundbars, speakers, games consoles, streaming devices), but that doesn’t mean your living room has to look cluttered. Our bespoke media walls are designed to integrate everything neatly, hiding wires and creating a polished focal point for the room.

chapters.heading: Media Walls Designed Around Your Lifestyle

blocks.html: No two families use their living space in the same way. That’s why we design each media wall individually. Need more shelving for books? Storage for a growing DVD or games collection? A minimalist design that blends into the room? We’ll create a design that reflects your lifestyle while enhancing your home’s interior.

blocks.alt: Media wall with built in units with book shelves and fire | Local Carpenter

blocks.html: A well-built media wall isn’t just about aesthetics: it’s about smart use of space. Our media walls often include built-in cabinets, bespoke shelving, alcove storage and even feature lighting. We ensure that your TV and sound system take centre stage while everything else has its place, keeping the room organised and stylish.

As carpenters and builders, we do more than just design: we manage the full installation. From framing and stud work to carpentry, plastering and finishing, every stage is handled in-house. Our NVQ-qualified team ensures your media wall installation is delivered to the highest standard, with no detail overlooked.

chapters.heading: Professional Cabinet Spraying for Flawless Media Wall Finish

blocks.html: While the structure of a media wall defines the space, the finish is what truly brings it to life. For that reason, we offer professional cabinet spraying as part of our media wall service. Ensuring a sleek, high-end result that elevates your living room.

Rather than relying on traditional brush or roller methods, our spraying creates a smooth, consistent finish across cabinets, shelving, and built-in units. As a result, your media walls look purpose-built and refined, with no visible brush marks or uneven textures. Moreover, this approach allows colours to flow seamlessly across the entire installation. Helping the wall sit naturally within your home’s interior.

Because media walls are a focal point, durability matters just as much as appearance. Therefore, we use professional-grade coatings designed to resist scuffs, marks, and everyday wear. Consequently, your cabinets and panels stay looking sharp for longer, even in busy family homes.

Importantly, our spraying is fully integrated with our carpentry work. This means preparation, finishing, and detailing are managed with precision, not treated as an afterthought. From careful surface preparation to controlled application and curing, every stage is managed to the same high standard.

By combining bespoke carpentry with expert cabinet spraying, we deliver media walls that feel cohesive, premium, and built to last. Ultimately, you benefit from a striking feature that enhances your living space, reduces visual clutter, and adds long-term value to your home.
